name: yeem01-workflow-core
description: Yeem01-backed public portable workflow suite with bundled operator skills, version-pinned onboarding, and redacted improvement feedback.

interface.shortDescription: Use YEEM's portable operator workflow suite.
interface.longDescription: Provides the Yeem01 command front door plus ten portable owners for audit and evaluation, planning, artifact output, QA, improvement, pipelines, research, project charters and user-skill capture, with version-pinned onboarding for Codex and compatible Agent Skills hosts while deferring project authority, credentials and external actions to the host.
defaultPrompt: Use -onboarding to learn the audit-to-improvement workflow.
Use -audit, -discuss and -plan all before committing to a material direction.
Use -qa after building, -evaluate after credible use, then -improve to propose the next change.
